hints.title: Contiguous Block Invariant
hints.text: All occurrences of equal elements appear contiguously in the big array.

hints.title: Binary Search on Endpoints
hints.text: Given the current block start index i, the first index j > i where the value changes can be located using binary search.

hints.title: Skipping Whole Blocks
hints.text: After finding the block boundary, increment block count and advance index i directly to the start of the next block.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary searching block boundaries across up to 10^15 elements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning times out since array size is up to 10^15.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use binary search on upper bounds to skip entire uniform intervals.
